sn35.143:1.1: Rūpā bhikkhave aniccā || yo pi hetu yo pi paccayo rūpānam uppādāya so pi anicco || aniccasambhūtā bhikkhave rūpā kuto niccā bhavissanti || || Saddā || || Gandhā || || Rasā || || Poṭṭhabbā || || Dhammā aniccā || yo pi hetu yo pi paccayo dhammānam uppādaya so pi anicco || aniccasambhūtā bhikkhave dhammā kuto niccā bhavissanti || || Evam passam || la || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || ||
